commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Peter Bankes has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+6' The game is interrupted. Ederson (Manchester City) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
90+3' Sasa Lukic (Fulham) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) on for Ilkay Gundogan.
89' 3 - 2 Goal - 3:2! Reiss Nelson laid the ball off to Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham), who shot from close range into the left side of the goal, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.

87' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Bernd Leno has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.

86' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Fulham are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
82' 3 - 1 Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) perfectly wriggles his way through two or three opponents, and he produces a shot from the edge of the box which goes into the roof of the net. Wonderful goal!
82' Manchester City seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
78' Substitution. Phil Foden makes his way off the pitch and John Stones (Manchester City) comes on as his replacement.

60' Wasted effort! Phil Foden (Manchester City) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fulham.

31' Wonderful movement by Manchester City. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.

29' CHANCE! Adama Traore (Fulham) picks up a perfect pass inside the box, makes himself some space for a shot, but his effort goes just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Manchester City will have a goal kick.
26' 0 - 1 Andreas Pereira (Fulham) collects a delightful pass inside the box and slashes the ball into the middle of the goal. What a clinical finish!

19' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) was too forceful with his tackle and Peter Bankes interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' Manchester City work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
17' Adama Traore (Fulham) unleashes a promising shot low towards the middle of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Ederson thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
17' Manchester City fail to score from a corner as Bernd Leno (Fulham) leaps to collect the ball.
16' Manchester City have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Manchester City earn a corner.

16' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play and Manchester City manage to earn a corner.

15' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
14' Phil Foden (Manchester City) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
14' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
13' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
